# Lead screen assets

Copied from the user's crm-itlife project to preserve its existing lead interface. These files are loaded only by the lead-management layout; upstream copyright headers are retained.

- SoftMaterial source theme: `master-style.css`, `bootstrap-extend.css`, `horizontal-menu.css`, `source-custom.css`, and relevant shared layout rules in `source-layout.css` (existing project assets; no new distribution rights are asserted).
- Bootstrap 4.1.1, jQuery 3.3.1, Popper (existing bundled version), FullCalendar 3.9.0 with Moment, Select2, and DataTables 1.10.16 with its Bootstrap adapter: retain their MIT/license notices in the files.
- Font Awesome Free 6.2.0: icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT; https://fontawesome.com/license/free
- SweetAlert2 11: MIT, downloaded from the same official jsDelivr package used by the source screen; its version/copyright header is retained.
- `tasmiya-shell.css` contains Tasmiya navigation styles only. Source theme imports for unrelated/missing icon libraries were removed; the bundled Font Awesome files supply the lead screen's icons.
